name: Yuzuru Satonaka
source:
Timid and lacking presence, he faces constant rejection even from part-time jobs. An aspiring game creator, he used to actively pitch his ideas, but after repeated failures, he has seemingly given up on life. Finally receiving a callback for an interview, he was rushing to the company when he was pulled into this nightmare.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4753680/Subway_0_Escape/]Steam[/url]]
